Energy: Android\'s battery report has no entry for Activity+ yet. The automatic measurement reads it every 3 hours on battery.
Energy is Android\'s own estimate from its battery report, an average over the days it covers. Everything else is counted by Android for Activity+.

Android counts only while the phone runs on battery, and Activity+ reads the counters once an hour, so a day can be off a little at its edges. Data stays at 0 B because Activity+ has no internet permission.
What runs in the background
The live status is off, so nothing of Activity+ runs on its own except the widgets below. Opening the app reads what it shows at that moment.

Activity+ holds no wake lock and sets no alarm. All of this runs on the live monitor\'s own timer, which sleeps when the phone sleeps. Heavy reports wait for the screen when it is off on battery, and do not run in Doze.
What does Activity+ itself cost?
Live monitor
Every %1$d s with the screen on, once a minute with it off, and one history row a minute. Stops in deep sleep.
Wakeup counters
Every 30 minutes on battery: one call to Android, no shell.
Sensor log
Every 30 minutes: Android\'s app-ops report (700 kB), read as a stream. Waits for the screen when it is off.
Power rails
Every 5 minutes: one reading of the power monitors.
Background measurement
Every 3 hours on battery, when you plug in and in the morning: Android\'s battery report, read as a stream. Waits for the screen when it is off.
App updates and data per app
Once a day, and shortly after an app is updated.
Storage history
Once a day. Waits for the screen when it is off.
Throttling log
When Android\'s heat status changes; nothing in between.
Night check
When the screen goes off or on, the plug changes or Doze changes; nothing in between.
This card\'s counters
Once an hour on battery, and when you open the card.
Weekly report
Monday morning: one notification.
Widgets
Every 30 seconds while the screen is on (by the live monitor), and by Android at most every 30 minutes.
